title: On the day his six-game suspension ended, Jed York attends quarterly NFL ownership meeting

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: On the day his six-game suspension ended, Jed York attends quarterly NFL ownership meeting
sources.description: On the same day his six-game suspension following an August arrest in Ohio ended, 49ers owner Jed York was present at the quarterly gathering of the most exclusive club in American sports.
